goal: Iske baad aap struct ke andar functions likh sakte hain, unhein dot operator se call kar sakte hain (s.print()), aur samjha sakte hain ke member function members ko dot ke baghair kyun use kar sakta hai.
warmup: Mobile phone ke bare mein sochein. Woh data rakhta hai (aap ke contacts, aap ka balance) aur kaam bhi kar sakta hai (call karna, balance dikhana, contact add karna). Pakistan mein SIM card ka record bhi aisa hi hai: us mein ek number aur balance hota hai, aur aap usay balance dikhane ya load add karne ko keh sakte hain. C++ mein struct bhi yehi kar sakta hai: woh data ko ek jagah rakhta hai aur un functions ko bhi rakhta hai jo us data par kaam karte hain.
definition: Member function aisa function hai jo struct ke ANDAR declare kiya jata hai. Yeh struct ka hissa hota hai, is liye struct ke data members ko dot operator ke baghair seedha use kar sakta hai. Aap isay struct ke variable (object) par dot operator se call karte hain: s1.print(). Struct mein saare members default tor par public hote hain, jis ka matlab hai ke bahar ka code unhein use kar sakta hai. (Class mein woh default tor par private hote hain. Yehi asal farq hai, aur classes aap agle course mein seekhenge.)
howItWorks: Pehla trace step by step dekhein aur call stack panel par nazar rakhein. Member function hamesha kisi object PAR call hota hai. s1.set("Ali", 80) mein dot se pehle wala hissa, s1, object hai. set ke andar name aur marks ka matlab s1.name aur s1.marks hai, kyunke function s1 par kaam kar raha hai. Isi liye andar dot ki zaroorat nahi parti. Jab hum baad mein s2.set("Sara", 92) call karte hain, to WOHI code chalta hai, lekin ab name aur marks ka matlab s2.name aur s2.marks hota hai. Har object apna data rakhta hai; functions saanjhe hote hain. Struct ke bahar hamein member tak pohanchne ke liye phir bhi dot chahiye: r.width, r.area(). Member function ke parameters ho sakte hain (jaise set), woh value return kar sakta hai (jaise area), aur true ya false bhi return kar sakta hai (jaise withdraw). Teesre trace mein dekhein: deposit acc ka balance badalta hai aur kuch return nahi karta, jabke withdraw pehle check karta hai aur bool return karta hai.
